content:
“Girls” star Zosia Mamet discussed her dad David Mamet’s love of President Donald Trump, suggesting she has struggled to make sense of it.

In an “Armchair Expert” podcast shared Monday, host Dax Shepard got the ball rolling by mentioning one of David Mamet’s 2025 interviews with Bill Maher. The Pulitzer-Prize-winning playwright, who has also written and directed several movies, told the host that the 2020 election was stolen from Trump. He also has said Trump “was the best president since Abraham Lincoln.”

“He’s very into Trump,” Shepard remarked.

“Yeah,” Zosia Mamet, who will be reprising her role as Shoshanna in the anticipated revival of “Girls,” replied.

“I didn’t know if he was fucking with everyone,” Shepard said.

“I don’t think he is,” she replied. “... I can tell you he’s not.”

The former “Mad Men” actor noted that her dad, known for plays such as “Speed-the-Plow” and “Glengarry Glen Ross” and films like “Things Change” and “The Spanish Prisoner,” was going to be honored by the Kennedy Center. Trump reportedly ordered his handpicked board to shut the place for renovations after a court rebuffed his effort to add his name to the building. (David Mamet will actually have his ceremony at DC’s Capital One Arena.)

Zosia Mamet, 38, said her younger sister Clara “called me almost in tears the other day and she was like, ’It’s not fair. Everybody else’s 80-year-old dad loves Trump, but they’re not famous.” (He turns 79 on Nov. 30.)

“It’s actually accurate,” she commented. “It’s not fair.”

Asked by Shepard whether David Mamet’s passion for Trump is an act, she replied, “Sometimes I think he commits to the bit so much. ... I don’t know where the bit ends, and he begins.”

Shepard said he had a hunch that her father is so brilliant that he gets bored easily and “entertains himself by fucking with people.”

“He’s the smartest human I’ve ever known in my life,” she replied. “He’s so funny and he works harder than anyone I know, and he consumes more than anyone I’ve ever met. The amount he reads, the amount he retains as well — he’s the best hang. He’s the best hang in the whole world.”
